exposure: Travel time categories (<30 min, 31-59 min, ≥60 min)
distance from home to delivery ward
Women at full term with spontaneous onset of labor
cohort: 364,630 women giving birth in Sweden between 2014 and 2017
finding: Longer travel time to the delivery ward was associated with increased odds of elective cesarean section, but women with the furthest to travel had reduced odds of PPH or OASIS.
mod_finding: Longer travel time was associated with increased odds of elective caesarean section.
